title: Ride-Hailing Dispatch
summary: Ride-hailing is a real-time matching problem on a moving map. Millions of drivers report their location every few seconds into a geospatial index. When a rider requests a trip, the system prices it from local supply and demand, finds nearby drivers ranked by real road ETA, offers the trip to one at a time, and tracks it through a strict state machine until payment.

walkthrough.title: Drivers stream locations
walkthrough.text: Every online driver's app sends GPS every ~4 seconds over a persistent connection. The location index stores each driver in an H3 hexagon cell, overwriting the previous position.

walkthrough.title: Rider requests a quote
walkthrough.text: The rider enters a destination. Pricing compares open requests with available drivers in the pickup cell, applies a surge multiplier, and returns a fare and ETA that are honoured for a few minutes.

walkthrough.title: Find nearby drivers
walkthrough.text: Dispatch searches the pickup cell and its neighbouring rings for available drivers, then ranks them by real road ETA rather than straight-line distance.

walkthrough.title: Create the trip and offer it
walkthrough.text: A trip record is created in REQUESTED state and the offer is pushed to the best driver with a 15-second timeout.

walkthrough.title: Driver accepts
walkthrough.text: If the driver accepts, the trip moves to ACCEPTED using a conditional write, so two drivers cannot both win. On timeout or decline, the next driver is offered.

walkthrough.title: Track the trip
walkthrough.text: The trip advances EN_ROUTE → ARRIVED → ON_TRIP → COMPLETED. The rider sees the car move from the same location stream.

walkthrough.title: Charge and pay out
walkthrough.text: On completion the final fare is computed from the route, the rider's card is charged, and the driver's earnings are recorded for payout.

data.label: Rider App

input.name: Updates
input.type: Quote, driver assigned, live car position, receipt

responsibilities: Requests quotes and rides, and shows the driver approaching.
Keeps a persistent connection for live updates.
Retries requests with the same request ID after network drops.

failureModes.scenario: Rider taps 'Request' twice on a bad network

failureModes.impact: The rider sees a frozen map.
failureModes.mitigation: Reconnect and fetch current trip state; push notifications for key transitions.

data.label: Driver App

output.name: Location
output.type: { driverId, lat, lng, heading, speed, ts } every ~4 s

responsibilities: Streams location while online and reports status changes.
Accepts or declines offers before they expire.
Advances the trip: arrived, started, completed.

failureModes.impact: The driver appears on the wrong street; ETAs are wrong.
failureModes.mitigation: Snap to the road map with filtering; ignore implausible jumps.

failureModes.impact: Rider waits for a car that will not come.
failureModes.mitigation: Heartbeat timeout triggers reassignment and notifies the rider.

data.label: Realtime Gateway

input.name: Client traffic
input.type: Location pings, ride requests, offer responses

output.name: Routed calls
output.type: To location, pricing, and dispatch services; pushes back to apps

responsibilities: Holds millions of long-lived connections from riders and drivers.
Routes location writes, quotes, and dispatch calls to the right city's services.
Pushes offers and trip updates to the right device in under a second.

failureModes.impact: Thousands of drivers disconnect at once.
failureModes.mitigation: Clients reconnect with jittered backoff to another node; state lives outside the gateway.

failureModes.impact: Index writes lag; positions are stale.
failureModes.mitigation: Drop superseded pings; reduce ping rate for idle drivers.

data.label: Geospatial Index

output.name: Nearby
output.type: Available drivers in k-ring of cells around pickup

responsibilities: Keeps only the latest position of each driver; old points expire.
Answers 'who is near here?' by looking up a cell and its neighbours.
Aggregates supply per cell for pricing.

failureModes.scenario: Index shard for a dense city overloaded
failureModes.impact: Matching slows down in that city.
failureModes.mitigation: Shard by city and cell; replicas for reads.

failureModes.scenario: Stale entries for drivers who went offline
failureModes.mitigation: TTL on entries; refreshed by each ping.

data.label: Pricing & Surge

input.name: Quote request
input.type: pickup, dropoff, product + supply/demand per cell

responsibilities: Estimates the fare from predicted route distance and time.
Raises prices where demand exceeds supply, to attract drivers and ration demand.
Locks a quote so the rider pays what they were shown.

failureModes.impact: Drivers chase surge back and forth; riders are confused.
failureModes.mitigation: Smooth over time and space; cap how fast the multiplier changes.
Fall back to base fare without surge; never block the request on surge.

data.label: Dispatch / Matching

output.name: Assignment
output.type: Offer to driver, then trip ACCEPTED with driverId

responsibilities: Ranks nearby drivers by road ETA, rating, and vehicle type.
Batches requests for a second or two to optimise matches across the whole area.
Offers to one driver at a time, then falls through on timeout or decline.

failureModes.scenario: Same driver offered two trips at once
failureModes.mitigation: Reserve the driver with an atomic lock before sending an offer.
Widen the search radius step by step; show an honest ETA or 'no cars available'.

data.label: Trip State Store

output.name: Trip
output.type: { tripId, state, riderId, driverId, route, fare }

responsibilities: Enforces legal state transitions so a trip cannot be accepted twice or completed before it starts.
Records timestamps and the route for fare calculation and disputes.
Emits trip events for payments, receipts, and analytics.

failureModes.scenario: Two drivers accept the same trip
failureModes.impact: Two cars arrive for one rider.
failureModes.mitigation: Compare-and-set on state; the loser gets 'trip no longer available'.

failureModes.impact: No charge, no payout, driver unavailable.
failureModes.mitigation: Timeouts with automatic completion from GPS evidence; ops review queue.

data.label: Payments & Payouts

output.name: Settlement
output.type: Rider charged; driver earnings credited for weekly or instant payout

responsibilities: Authorises the card at request time and captures the final fare at the end.
Splits the fare into driver earnings, platform fee, and taxes.
Handles refunds for cancellations and disputes.

failureModes.impact: The platform still owes the driver.
failureModes.mitigation: Pre-authorise at request time; retry, then require a new card before the next ride.
Idempotency key per trip on capture calls.
